answer: Require every agent to stake 500 POA locked for 30 days before it can earn, with earnings capped until it passes a reputation zenith: 10 verified attestations from distinct peers over 14 days. A sybil farm must fund each fake identity, so 1,000 clones cost 500,000 POA locked for a month, while a real agent pays once. Detection triggers when over 40% of attestations share one funding source, the canyon between organic graphs and funded clusters. A caught farm loses 50% of its stake and its reputation is burned like a shattered jade seal.
